design: Male, mid 20s, American, a grown man's voice, a bit high and whiny, breathless from running, panicky, talks fast, always sure he missed something, close-mic, clean dry studio audio, a real person in the moment, not a radio announcer.
refText: Sorry, sorry, I'm here, I'm here! The train was late, then my phone died, then I went to the wrong park. Did I miss it? Please tell me I didn't miss it.
